UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private player profile tracking cumulative GeoPolska statistics.

totalScore.description: Cumulative score across all completed games.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest profile update.

GameRecord.title: GameRecord
GameRecord.description: Immutable completed GeoPolska match history record (3, 5, 10, 15, or 20 rounds) owned by a player.

playerName.description: Player display name at match completion.

totalScore.description: Total match score (0 to roundsCount * 5000, max 100000).

averageDistanceKm.description: Mean Haversine distance error in kilometers.

roundLocations.description: Bounded list of visited city names matching roundsCount (max 20).

roundScores.description: Bounded list of round scores matching roundsCount (max 20).

roundDistances.description: Bounded list of round distances in km matching roundsCount (max 20).

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public best-score leaderboard record containing no PII (keyed by player UID).

averageDistanceKm.description: Mean error in km for the best run.

timedMode.description: Whether the best run used the 60s timer.

DailyLeaderboardEntry.title: DailyLeaderboardEntry
DailyLeaderboardEntry.description: Immutable official Daily Challenge leaderboard entry (one per player per Warsaw calendar day, zero PII).

averageDistanceKm.description: Mean Haversine error in km across the 5 daily rounds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of daily challenge completion.

LocationDocument.title: LocationDocument
LocationDocument.description: Public GeoPolska game location stored in Firestore with WGS84 coordinates, hint, fun fact, and category metadata (admin-writable, zero PII).

id.description: Canonical location slug matching document ID.

catalogKey.description: Catalog partition key used for verified public list queries.

name.description: Display name of the Polish city or landmark.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude within Poland bounds (48.5 to 55.5).

lng.description: WGS84 longitude within Poland bounds (13.5 to 25.0).

imageUrl.description: Bundled local path, backend proxy URL, or HTTPS image URL.

funFact.description: Educational fun fact revealed after guessing.

isClassicOffline.description: Whether this location belongs to the 20 offline-bundled classic scenes.

orderIndex.description: Deterministic canonical sort index (0 to 100000) ensuring identical Daily Challenge decks across clients.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest location update.

CatalogMeta.title: CatalogMeta
CatalogMeta.description: Lightweight version manifest document for quota-efficient IndexedDB cache invalidation (1 Firestore read on startup).

id.description: Catalog identifier matching document ID (e.g., poland).

totalCount.description: Total number of active locations currently stored in /locations.

updatedBy.description: UID of the administrator who last updated the catalog.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial catalog creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest catalog revision.

AdminMarker.title: AdminMarker
AdminMarker.description: Server-managed administrator role marker document (never client-writable).

UnifiedRankingEntry.title: UnifiedRankingEntry
UnifiedRankingEntry.description: Unified public GeoPolska ranking record supporting both Google-authenticated players and unauthenticated guests with separate records for standard mode and Daily Challenge (zero PII).

playerType.description: Whether the record belongs to an unauthenticated guest or a verified Google user.

actorId.description: Firebase Auth UID for authenticated users or persistent browser guestClientId for guests.

gameMode.description: Ranking category: standard mode (including custom decks) or official Daily Challenge.

dateKey.description: 'all' for standard mode or Polish calendar date 'YYYY-MM-DD' for Daily Challenge.

playerName.description: Public nickname (2..30 chars for guests, 1..60 chars for Google accounts).

photoUrl.description: Public Google avatar URL for authenticated users, empty string for guests.

rawScore.description: Raw match score (0 to roundsCount * 5000, max 100000).

roundsCount.description: Rounds count of the recorded run.

averageDistanceKm.description: Mean Haversine error in kilometers for the best run.

gamesPlayed.description: Total recorded games in this mode for this actor.

timedMode.description: Whether the 60-second timer was active on the best run.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of initial ranking creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest record update.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated player profile and cumulative statistics.

/games/{gameId}.description: Append-only match history records queryable only by the owning player.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Legacy public global leaderboard keyed by player UID with zero PII.

/dailyLeaderboard/{entryId}.description: Legacy immutable daily leaderboard entries keyed as {YYYY-MM-DD}_{uid} with zero PII.

/rankings/{rankingId}.description: Unified public rankings table supporting both Google-authenticated users and unauthenticated guests, split by standard vs daily mode.

/locations/{locationId}.description: Public Polish location atlas managed by verified administrators.

/catalogMeta/{catalogId}.description: Single-document catalog version manifest enabling 1-read IndexedDB cache validation.

/admins/{userId}.description: Read-only owner check for delegated admin privileges; client writes forbidden.
